rule: Use the richest reliable provider first, but normalize every result into Boundary-Set-v1 before rendering.

routing.note: OSM is preferred for European administrative detail. geoBoundaries fills gaps or countries whose OSM extraction is not yet curated.
Outside Europe, geoBoundaries is the first global coverage provider.

default_europe.note: OSM admin_level is country-specific. These defaults must be overridden when a national hierarchy differs.

DEU.note: ADM2 follows counties/district-free cities for EarthMap statistics. Regierungsbezirke can be modeled as an intermediate national variant when needed.

GBR.note: Home nations and devolved structures must be preserved through Boundary-Set categorization.

file_naming.rule: The filename is a human-readable label only. valid_from and valid_to in Boundary-Set-v1 are authoritative.
